description: Activate the selected Explore searches as Monitor tracking using the supplied preview plan and complete bindings. Creates, extends or reuses Monitor scope, reconciles workspace defaults and may queue baseline collection under existing credit controls. Returns activation status, identifiers and blocking reasons; collected results are available later. Requires an explicit workspace and idempotencyKey; supply confirmedScopeFingerprint only after requested scope confirmation.

body.description: Optional complete canonical activateSearches body; explicit fields override it.

confirmedScopeFingerprint.description: Required only when the activation preview returned confirmationRequired; echo the reviewed planFingerprint once after the principal confirms the aggregate scope, reusing the same idempotencyKey.

name: socialseal_explore_activate_searches
title: Activate Explore searches
